items.author: support@clockpoint.example
items.title: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts
items.body:
Dear Njeri,

Thank you for contacting ClockPoint Support. Your ticket CP-48213 has been assigned to me.

So that I can reproduce the problem, please reply with:
1. Terminal model and current firmware version
2. The shift template the affected staff are on
3. One example employee ID with the clock-in/clock-out times, what the export showed and what you expected
4. Which export profile you use to feed payroll
5. When you first noticed the issue

Kind regards,
Faith Achieng
Tier 2 Support Engineer, ClockPoint Systems

items.author: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
items.title: October overtime - something is off with the export
items.body:
Njeri,

Found it. I first noticed the problem today, 5 November, while reviewing the draft October overtime. Night shift at Embakasi depot (NIGHT-8 template, 22:00-06:00). Since about 28 Oct the Payroll CSV v2 export is splitting any shift that crosses midnight into two lines, and the after-midnight line is coded OT15 instead of REG.

Example: T-0417, clocked in 21:54 on 30 Oct, out 06:07 on 31 Oct. Export shows 2.1 hrs REG on 30 Oct and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 Oct. Should be 8.0 hrs REG plus 0.2 hrs OT15. Payroll rounds durations to the nearest tenth of an hour: the 8 h 13 min total is 8.2 hrs, with the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift coded OT15.

Affects 38 staff on nights. Draft October overtime came out about KES 212,000 too high. I've held the overtime lines and corrected manually from the raw punches, but I can't do that every month. Mombasa Road day shift is fine.

Kevin

items.author: brian.ochieng@tausifreight.example
items.title: Re: clock terminals
items.body: Hi Njeri, confirming the four BX-300 terminals at Embakasi auto-updated from firmware 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 Oct. The two at Mombasa Road are still on 4.1.8 because they were offline that week. I can roll Embakasi back but I'd rather the vendor tells us whether that is safe, I don't want to lose punch data. Brian

items.author: news@clockpoint.example
items.title: ClockPoint firmware 4.2.1 is rolling out
items.body: Firmware 4.2.1 for BX-series terminals brings faster fingerprint matching, offline punch buffering of up to 30 days, and improved midnight rollover handling for shifts that span two calendar days. Terminals with auto-update enabled will update automatically over the coming week.
